crowdsourced_ids_results.rule_msg: ET USER_AGENTS Suspicious User Agent (Microsoft Internet Explorer)
crowdsourced_ids_results.rule_raw: alert http $HOME_NET any -> $EXTERNAL_NET any (msg:"ET USER_AGENTS Suspicious User Agent (Microsoft Internet Explorer)"; flow:established,to_server; threshold:type limit, track by_src, count 2, seconds 360; http.user_agent; content:"Microsoft Internet Explorer"; depth:28; http.host; content:!"bbc.co.uk"; content:!"vmware.com"; content:!"rc.itsupport247.net"; content:!"msn.com"; content:!"msn.es"; content:!"live.com"; content:!"gocyberlink.com"; content:!"ultraedit.com"; content:!"windowsupdate.com"; content:!"cyberlink.com"; content:!"lenovo.com"; content:!"itsupport247.net"; content:!"msn.co.uk"; content:!"support.weixin.qq.com"; reference:url,doc.emergingthreats.net/bin/view/Main/2002400; classtype:trojan-activity; sid:2002400; rev:37; metadata:created_at 2010_07_30, former_category HUNTING, updated_at 2020_08_31;)
alert ( gid:116; sid:424; rev:2; msg:"(eth) truncated ethernet header"; metadata: policy max-detect-ips drop, rule-type decode; classtype:misc-activity;)

crowdsourced_ids_results.rule_msg: (http_inspect) HTTP start line or header line terminated by LF without a CR
crowdsourced_ids_results.rule_raw: alert ( gid:119; sid:13; rev:3; msg:"(http_inspect) HTTP start line or header line terminated by LF without a CR"; metadata: policy max-detect-ips drop, rule-type preproc; service:http; classtype:unknown;)

alert icmp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET any ( msg:"PROTOCOL-ICMP Destination Unreachable Network Unreachable"; icode:0; itype:3; metadata:ruleset community; classtype:misc-activity; sid:401; rev:9; )

crowdsourced_ids_results.rule_msg: POLICY-OTHER HTTP request by IPv4 address attempt
crowdsourced_ids_results.rule_raw: alert tcp any any -> any $HTTP_PORTS ( msg:"POLICY-OTHER HTTP request by IPv4 address attempt"; flow:to_server,established; http_header; content:"Host:",fast_pattern,nocase; pcre:"/^Host\x3a\s*(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9]?[0-9])\s*:?\s*\d*\s*$/ims"; service:http; reference:url,www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec15.html; classtype:policy-violation; sid:50447; rev:1; )
